text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A, D and E after gains, which felt rewarding; I should not let that satisfaction alone decide when to sell or make me reluctant to realize a loss.","Buying all five stocks in Period 4 broadened my holdings, but I should size positions around risk and diversification rather than treat equal purchases as automatically suitable.","With prices moving randomly and no trades in most periods, I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and make deliberate decisions based on my plan, not recent performance or my average cost."]}
